newsitem.title: USA: MEHL/Biophile teams with Applied Genetics.
newsitem.headline: MEHL/Biophile teams with Applied Genetics.

text.p: MEHL/Biophile International Corp said on Thursday it had formed a strategic alliance with Applied Genetics Inc.
The alliance is for developing liposome-based skin care products for use with the MEHL laser hair-removal system.

The agreement calls for an infusion of capital by MEHL to fund research and development of the products, as well as plans for an equity investment by MEHL in the privately-held Applied Genetics, MEHL said.
It did not further detail the terms of the deal.
The products coming out of the deal will be marketed throughout the MEHL/SLS network of laser hair removal centers, which are projected to reach 300 by the end of 1997, the company said.
